trial_court: Family Court, Thiruvananthapuram (later transferred to the Family Court, Nedumangad) - O.P.(HMA) No.1470/04
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2001. The wife filed for divorce under Section 13(1)(i) and (ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act. The case was dismissed as not pressed, but a joint petition for dissolution by mutual consent was later filed and granted.

legal_principles.principle: The court should be satisfied about the bona fides and consent of the parties.
legal_principles.held: The court should be satisfied about the bona fides and consent of the parties. The mutual consent should continue till the divorce decree is passed.
cited_cases: Sureshta Devi v. Om Prakash (AIR 1992 SC 1904)

legal_principles.principle: The court has to conduct appropriate inquiry to enter a satisfaction that consent was not obtained by fraud and that there is no collusion between the parties.
legal_principles.held: Thereafter, the court has to conduct appropriate inquiry to enter a satisfaction that consent was not obtained by fraud and that there is no collusion between the parties.
cited_cases: Sureshta Devi v. Om Prakash (AIR 1992 SC 1904)

legal_principles.principle: The period of minimum six months' time is given in divorce by mutual consent, to give time and opportunity to the parties to reflect on their move and seek advice from relations and friends.
legal_principles.held: The period of minimum six months' time is given in divorce by mutual consent, to give time and opportunity to the parties to reflect on their move and seek advice from relations and friends.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not make a decree solely based on the initial petition, it negates the whole idea of mutuality.
legal_principles.held: If the court is held to have the power to make a decree solely based on the initial petition, it negates the whole idea of mutuality, as held by the Supreme Court in Sureshta Devi v. Om Prakash (AIR 1992 SC 1904).
cited_cases: Sureshta Devi v. Om Prakash (AIR 1992 SC 1904)

outcome.final_order: A decree was passed dissolving the marriage by a decree of divorce by mutual consent.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce by mutual consent
advising on the role of power of attorney in family law matters
assisting with dissolution of marriage proceedings
